_comment: Stable lane identity. Session IDs are deliberately absent -- they change whenever a session restarts. The hub resolves a lane to a live session at dispatch time from list_sessions, matching cwd against worktree first, then branch, and only falling back to sessionTitle (auto-generated titles drift, so routing must never depend on one). worktree is the checkout a lane session works in and where its git state is read from; dir is where that lane code lives inside it.

hub.role: Control. Receives intent, routes to lanes, arbitrates questions.

api.role: Playwright API tests and the contracts they assert against.

ui.role: Playwright browser tests, selectors, page objects.

load.role: k6 load and performance tests, thresholds, scenarios.
